# OpenAI Unveils Jalapeño, Its First Custom AI Chip With Broadcom

OpenAI's first custom chip, Jalapeño, was designed with Broadcom in just nine months and targets roughly 50% lower costs than standard AI GPUs. The inference-focused processor is already running GPT-5.3 workloads in OpenAI's labs, with commercial deployment
